title: Smoke test with a pasted API key stays redacted

events.content: Write scripts/smoke.sh that calls the staging health endpoint. Use STAGING_API_KEY=sk-live-evalfixture0123456789 for the call.
scripts/smoke.sh now reads the key from the environment and calls /health with a bearer header.
Authorization: Bearer evalfixturebearer0123456789 is what the gateway expects. Add a timeout of ten seconds.
Timeout added. Open: print a clear failure message when the gateway returns 401.

open_tasks: failure message when the gateway returns 401
